messages:
neha: FYI partner ingestion service accidentally logged payloads to their debug endpoint. Payload includes a KMS ciphertext and an older service account private key blob. No plaintext seen in our logs but we should treat as credential-exposure and coordinate rotation/scrub. Suggestions: revoke old SA key, rewrap ciphertext to new KMS key, rotate DB password if needed, and tighten Vault access for partner paths. Who takes triage?
tariq: I can take the SA key rotation. Which SA and key id?
neha: svc-ingest@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com, key id = d9f1c3-old. Its referenced in the webhook dump.
tariq: Ok revoking now. Command: 
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete d9f1c3-old --iam-account=svc-ingest@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
elliot: Quick KMS note: since the logfile has ciphertext blob only, we should rewrap rather than immediate secret rotation. Rewrap steps (do on isolated host): 
```
gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=rw-keyring --key=stage-v1 --ciphertext-file=ct.blob --plaintext-file=ct.plain
# verify on offline node, then:
gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=rw-keyring --key=stage-v2 --plaintext-file=ct.plain --ciphertext-file=ct.rewrapped
rm -f ct.plain
```
elliot: I'll run the rewrap on a locked-down secops VM and upload rewrapped blob to gs://secops/rewraps/.
vault-bot: Audit device 'splunk-forward' is active; recently received 78 events in last 5m.
ops-oncall: Schedule note  we should do a short partner maintenance window (30m) to hand off new SA key and re-deploy any ingest clients. I'll message the partner and open an incident for tracking.
neha: Timeline proposal: tariq revokes + create new key within 20m; elliot rewraps within 90m; neha apply temporary Vault deny-read policy on partner path within 15m and enable full audit-forwarding; ops-oncall handle partner comms and incident ticket.
tariq: Revoke done, returned 200. Created new key and stored in gs://redwood-secops/keys/svc-ingest-new.json (ACL: seceng-only). I messaged partner secure channel for pickup.
elliot: Rewrap completed on secops VM, uploaded to gs://secops/rewraps/ingest-2026-03-22.rewrapped, and validated by decrypting on a staging node using stage-v2. No plaintext persisted.
neha: Applying short-term Vault policy to restrict reads on secret/data/ingest/partner/* and force writes-only for the partner role. Will add allowlist for seceng service account to validate. Policy snippet applied: 
```
path "secret/data/ingest/partner/*" {
  capabilities = ["create","update"]
}
path "secret/data/ingest/partner/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
  allowed_parameters = { "allowed_entities" = [] }
}
```
vault-bot: Policy 'ingest-partner-lock' created by neha at 2026-03-22T09:12:00Z. Audit forward enabled on mount 'audit/' to splunk-forward.
ops-oncall: Incident INC-2026-331 created and scheduled 24h postmortem. Partner notified of 30m maintenance window starting 09:30 UTC. PagerDuty rule added to alert on Vault deny errors > 5/min.
neha: Action items: tariq = SA revoke + new key handoff (done); elliot = rewrap + verification (done); neha = Vault policy + audit forwarding (done); ops-oncall = incident + partner comms (done). Please add a short runbook PR to infra-runbooks referencing commands we ran and tag eng-security.
tariq: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/infra-runbooks/pulls/82 with revoke/create steps and secure delivery notes.
elliot: Postmortem note: ask partner to disable verbose body logging and implement redaction in their webhook agent. Also recommend rotating their ingest role keys quarterly.
neha: I'll coordinate long-term Vault onboarding changes with IAM team (least-privilege onboarding). Closing this triage unless we see audit spikes. :thumbsup:
